title: skills(pm-dispatch): grading reads the checklist ITEM, not the area — `Path:` carries the item id, the card inherits the item's P, and 「有人在等」 is not a test
body:
Path: none

Finding class (b), surfaced by the maintainer's first sweep batch (2026-09-19): the triage seat mapped every card onto a checklist AREA (access-security, studio-authoring, …) and read the hit as 「清单上的能力断了」, so 8 of 8 cards graded P0–P2 and none closed; it then substituted 「有人在等吗」 as the tie-breaker. Maintainer ruling, verbatim: 「我们是一个开发工具,应该考虑北极星有没有这个需求,有人在等吗 是个伪命题」.

仪器 question (北极星「仪器为车队服务」): which fleet decision differs — every grading in the two-repo sweep (≈965 cards) and every first-touch grading after it; the seat re-graded one batch by hand already. ⇒ p1 (blocks the maintainer's live sweep).

The law's test, made mechanical: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` carries 264 items with ids (`<area>.<slug>`) and their own `priority` (P0/P1/…). A card is 「在清单上」 only when it can name the item that would FAIL because of it; a card that merely touches an area is not. The card's level inherits the item's P when the capability is broken, P2 when it runs but errs; no item and no path step ⇒ `none` ⇒ p3 or not planned. Named users, pull, or 「有人在等」 are never a test — the North Star's definition list, the path and the checklist are.

Scope (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, ceiling 812 / 812 line-neutral, every line ≤ 120 B; twins in `references/core-rules.md` and `references/lanes/triage.md` if either carries the grading line — grep first):
1. :362 `Path: P<n> | <清单区> | none` → `Path: <清单项 id> | P<路步> | none` (the item id from `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`, or the path step of 「唯一的度量,那条路」, or `none`).
2. One line (fold a neighbour to pay for it): 命中清单区 ≠ 能力断了;写不出会 fail 的清单项 / 断的路步 ⇒ `none` ⇒ p3 或不做;定级继承该项的 `priority`(断)或 P2(能跑但错);⛔「有人在等」「拉动」不是判据.
3. The 分诊缺口 rule at :461 stays (a missing `Path:` line is the round-report gap); `Path: none` is a written answer, not a gap.

Acceptance greps (control on `origin/main`): 「清单项」 in SKILL.md ≥ 1 (control 0 in this sense — `清单区` is what main says); 「有人在等」 in SKILL.md 1 as a negative rule (control 0); `Path:` in SKILL.md ≥ 2 (control 2). Gates: `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (812 / 812), `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:pm-half-states`. Governed: `.claude/**` = Tier S ⇒ draft PR, the skills seat's contract-tier record lands it.

Not in scope: the North Star text itself (the maintainer's; a clause 「清单上的能力断了 = 指得出会 fail 的清单项」 is offered to the maintainer in chat) and the checklist files.
